_real_world.role: Anti-ship cruise missile, air-launched from F/A-18E/F Block III (legacy secondary anti-ship weapon, LRASM is the preferred CVW-8 anti-ship weapon)
_real_world.guidance_real: Sea-skimming, radar-altimeter cruise; active radar terminal; sea-skim or pop-up attack profile; Block II+ adds GPS and datalink
_real_world.mount_mapping: none — no NavalWeaponType exists for anti-ship missiles; placed in CVW-8 F/A-18E/F default_loadout and _real_world.weapon_inventory. Distinct record from the packet-1 CSG_US_Harpoon_Ship_Launched (RGM-84 canister-launched with rocket booster) since the air-launched AGM-84 omits the booster stage and has materially lower all-up mass

mass_kg.note: OOB page's Harpoon weight row states 1,523 lb (690.8 kg) 'with booster' for the surface-launched RGM-84; the air-launched AGM-84 omits the separable rocket booster used only for canister/deck launch, so 526 kg is derived by subtracting the publicly-known Harpoon booster mass class (~165 kg, generic Harpoon booster-stage literature) from the sourced with-booster figure as an engineering estimate, since the OOB page does not separately publish an air-launched-specific weight

max_flight_time_s.note: engineering estimate derived from the ~67-120 nmi range band at the used ~240 m/s speed proxy, matching the repo CSG_US_Harpoon_Ship_Launched pattern

flight_model.max_speed.note: RAN (allied government, A) states 'high subsonic' only; ~0.75 Mach sea-level ~240 m/s used as engineering estimate, identical basis to the repo CSG_US_Harpoon_Ship_Launched (post-booster cruise speed is the same for both launch modes)

modeling_notes: No functional mount exists (mechanism gap, anti-ship missile); content-only for CVW-8 F/A-18E/F default_loadout and _real_world.weapon_inventory. Per the OOB page, Harpoon is carried by F/A-18A-F among USN launch platforms; LRASM (CSG_US_AGM-158C_LRASM) is the preferred/primary CVW-8 anti-ship weapon per DOT&E FY25, with air-launched Harpoon retained as a legacy secondary option. This record intentionally duplicates most of the repo CSG_US_Harpoon_Ship_Launched's warhead/guidance/fuze fields (same missile family, same seeker/warhead) while differing in mass_kg (booster omitted) to avoid asserting a false distinction where none exists publicly.
